Venous blood samples were collected after admission to the intensive care unit (ICU) of the HDZ NRW (median: 2 days after admission). In cases of transferring a patient to a normal ward (NW) of the HDZ NRW, another sample was taken (median: 2 days after transfer).
Of the patients enrolled in the study, eleven died (ICU A, n = 11), and six survived (ICU B, n = 6).
